results.title: Who is expected to complete tertiary education?
results.content: Institutions can lose up to 3.75% of core funding if average completion time exceeds programme duration by over a year – highlighting the emphasis placed on timely graduation within the funding model [(OECD, 2021[4])](/en/publications/education-at-a-glance-2025_1c0d9c79-en/full-report/who-is-expected-to-complete-tertiary-education_a1099e2e.html#Kappa_c8217325_77b4b32dbb). In the United Kingdom, for example, all higher education institutions are private but receive most of their funding from the government while in many OECD countries with significant shares of students attending private institutions there are no such government-dependent private institutions [(OECD, 2025[21])](/en/publications/education-at-a-glance-2025_1c0d9c79-en/full-report/who-is-expected-to-complete-tertiary-education_a1099e2e.html#OEC251_77b4b32dbb). For example, in many public institutions in Austria, students do not need to pass an admission exam to start a study programme [(OECD/European Union, 2019[27])](/en/publications/education-at-a-glance-2025_1c0d9c79-en/full-report/who-is-expected-to-complete-tertiary-education_a1099e2e.html#Kappa_1c45127b_77b4b32dbb) whereas more selective entry procedures for private institutions may result in better-prepared student cohorts. Women account for just 30% of new entrants to STEM fields, yet in most contexts, a larger share of women change programmes or level before graduating compared to men [(OECD, 2025[21])](/en/publications/education-at-a-glance-2025_1c0d9c79-en/full-report/who-is-expected-to-complete-tertiary-education_a1099e2e.html#OEC251_77b4b32dbb).

results.title: COURSE CATALOG
results.content: In support of this mission, SFCC will: • Prepare our students to accomplish their goals in college transfer, career development, skill attainment, or life-long learning through exemplary education and support services. 4 STATE FAIR COMMUNITY COLLEGE – ACADEMIC CATALOG 2025-2026 Programs of Study Institutional Learning Outcomes and General Education Competencies State Fair Community College believes a core of learning experiences exists that are invaluable to all students regardless of their present or future roles in the workplace and the community. Basic course includes instruction on entry level skills and knowledge to: identify and set up the types of Gas Metal Arc Welding (GMAW) and Flux Core Arc Welding (FCAW) equipment; identify types and specifications of GMAW/FCAW electrodes; set up and perform fillet and groove GMAW/FCAW welds in flat, horizontal, vertical, and overhead positions. Advanced course includes instruction on Gas Metal Arc 171 STATE FAIR COMMUNITY COLLEGE – ACADEMIC CATALOG 2025-2026 Course Descriptions Welding (GMAW), Pulse Gas Metal Arc Welding (GMAW P), and Flux Core Arc Welding (FCAW) equipment to perform welds and weldments on Aluminum and Stainless Steel.
